transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, to be honest, what really scared me enough to come in today is... I've been hearing things. Like, I keep hearing my name being called. It happens from the hallway at home, and it even happened once at the warehouse where I work, when I knew for a fact nobody else was around. And the thing is, it sounds completely real. Just as clear as if my husband was standing right next to me saying it.
When did you first start hearing your name being called?

Well, it started during this... this stretch I had where I was barely sleeping. I was just talking nonstop and felt completely driven to fix everything around me. That's when I first heard it. 

Before that, I never experienced anything like it. And actually, once I kind of crashed and fell into this really low, withdrawn period, it stopped. I haven't had any voices or... or strange beliefs like that since I've been feeling so down.
Have you ever heard voices or had unusual beliefs during a period when your mood was neither unusually elevated nor depressed?

No, I haven't. Like I said, it only happened during that time when I was barely sleeping and talking a mile a minute, trying to fix everything. Before that started, I never heard anything. And now that I'm in this low, withdrawn phase, it's completely stopped. I haven't heard any voices or had any strange thoughts since my mood dropped. It was just during that one really intense period.
